name: House Churches
overview: The New Testament reveals that early believers regularly met in homes, emphasizing intimate fellowship and steadfast devotion to apostolic teaching, prayer, and breaking of bread together. Jesus promises His presence when even a small number gather in His name, highlighting the spiritual significance of these gatherings. The book of Acts portrays house churches as vibrant centers of worship, teaching, and communal life, where believers shared meals and joyfully proclaimed Christ both publicly and from house to house.
